---- MODULE CahillSerializability ----
EXTENDS CahillSerializabilityDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL CSBackend == INSTANCE TLAPS

LEMMA CSEmptyHistoryRange == Range(<<>>) = {}
  BY CSBackend!SMTT("r10") DEF Range

LEMMA CSEmptyHistoryCommitted == CommittedTxns(<<>>) = {}
  BY CSEmptyHistoryRange, CSBackend!SMTT("r10")
    DEF CommittedTxns, SelectEvents

LEMMA CSNoCommittedGraph ==
  \A h : CommittedTxns(h) = {} => CahillMVSG(h) = {}
  BY CSBackend!SMTT("r10") DEF CahillMVSG

LEMMA CSEmptyGraphAcyclic == ~IsCycle({})
  BY CSBackend!SMTT("r10") DEF IsCycle, FindAllNodesInAnyCycle

LEMMA CSNoCommittedSerializable ==
  \A h : CommittedTxns(h) = {} => CahillSerializable(h)
  BY CSNoCommittedGraph, CSEmptyGraphAcyclic, CSBackend!SMTT("r10")
    DEF CahillSerializable

LEMMA CSInitialSerializable == Init => CahillSerializable(history)
  BY CSEmptyHistoryCommitted, CSNoCommittedSerializable,
     CSBackend!SMTT("r10") DEF Init

LEMMA CSHistoryStuttering ==
  CahillSerializable(history) /\ UNCHANGED history
    => CahillSerializable(history')
  BY CSBackend!SMTT("r10")
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM CahillSerializableCorrect == Spec => []CahillSerializable(history)
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF CahillSSI/CahillSerializability_CahillSerializableCorrect.tla
<1>1. Init => CahillSerializable(history)
  BY CSInitialSerializable, CSBackend!SMTT("r10")
<1>2. CahillSerializable(history) /\ [Next]_allvars
        => (CahillSerializable(history))'
  <2>1. ASSUME CahillSerializable(history),
               [Next]_allvars
        PROVE CahillSerializable(history')
    <3>1. CASE UNCHANGED allvars
      BY <2>1, <3>1, CSHistoryStuttering, CSBackend!SMTT("r10")
        DEF allvars
    \* The remaining branch needs strengthening by a state invariant
    \* relating the conflict flags, transaction lifetimes, and graph edges.
    <3>2. CASE Next
      BY <2>1, <3>2, CSBackend!SMTT("r30")
        DEF Next, CahillSerializable, IsCycle, CahillMVSG,
            FindAllNodesInAnyCycle
    <3>3. QED BY <2>1, <3>1, <3>2, CSBackend!SMTT("r10")
  <2>2. QED BY <2>1, CSBackend!SMTT("r10")
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, CSBackend!PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF CahillSSI/CahillSerializability_CahillSerializableCorrect.tla
====
